Single-purpose macOS overlay launcher for Charles's Bear-based second brain. Press a global hotkey, a flat themed bar opens, type a thought, hit Enter — then a destination picker filters projects/people/personal areas as you type. Enter on the pinned Inbox row (or with nothing typed) sends the capture to the pinned Bear "Inbox" note; Enter on a destination files it **immediately**, verbatim, into that note. A second hotkey opens Process Inbox: Tinder-style triage of existing inbox items.

```
capture:  ⏎ text → picker → ⏎ dest ──BearCLI casEdit──▶ dest note's section (see below)
                          → ⏎ inbox ──BearCLI casEdit──▶ Inbox note (prepend under H1)
triage:   entry prefilled (editable) → picker → ⏎ dest    same, under the entry's ORIGINAL timestamp, + remove block
                                              → ⏎ inbox   keep it in the Inbox and move on (same as ⇥)
                                              → ⌘⌫        remove block only  ·  ⇥ skip  ·  esc exit
any bearcli failure ─▶ DailyCapture.send(text, marker:) → Inbox via x-callback + notification
```
- **Ranking**: title-prefix 100 > word-boundary 80 > fuzzy subsequence 40+compactness, plus recency `20·exp(−ageDays/14)` and MRU `15·exp(−idx/5)` keyed by note id. Empty query = top rows by recency+MRU with Inbox pinned at row 0, so ⏎⏎ means "straight to inbox" (capture) or "keep it there" (triage).
Credentials stay in your macOS Keychain. An unused connection expires after 30 days; sign in again from Settings.

## Process Inbox

`⌃⌘⇧Space` (or the menu item) triages existing inbox entries oldest-first, one at a time — prefilled and editable, with a `4/31` counter:

| Action | Result |
|---|---|
| `Enter` → type + `Enter` | File to the matched destination and remove from the Inbox |
| `Enter` → `Enter` (empty) | Keep it in the Inbox and move on |
| `⌘⌫` | Discard (remove from the Inbox) |
| `Tab` | Skip (leave in the Inbox) |
| `Esc` | Exit |

Every decision advances instantly; the Bear writes happen behind it.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Build a Release configuration of Capture and zip the .app bundle for GitHub Releases.
#
# Usage: scripts/release.sh 0.1.0
#
# Output: dist/Capture-v<VERSION>.zip
#
# Upload to a GitHub Release with:
#   gh release create v<VERSION> dist/Capture-v<VERSION>.zip --title "Capture v<VERSION>"

set -euo pipefail

if [[ $# -ne 1 ]]; then
  echo "Usage: $0 <version>" >&2
  echo "Example: $0 0.1.0" >&2
  exit 1
fi

VERSION="$1"

command -v xcodegen  >/dev/null || { echo "xcodegen not found. brew install xcodegen" >&2; exit 1; }
command -v xcodebuild >/dev/null || { echo "xcodebuild not found. Install Xcode." >&2; exit 1; }

cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."

rm -rf build dist
mkdir -p dist

xcodegen generate

xcodebuild \
  -project Capture.xcodeproj \
  -scheme Capture \
  -configuration Release \
  -derivedDataPath build \
  ARCHS="arm64 x86_64" \
  ONLY_ACTIVE_ARCH=NO \
  MARKETING_VERSION="$VERSION" \
  CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION="$VERSION" \
  clean build

APP_PATH="build/Build/Products/Release/Capture.app"
if [[ ! -d "$APP_PATH" ]]; then
  echo "Build succeeded but $APP_PATH not found" >&2
  exit 1
fi

ZIP_PATH="dist/Capture-v${VERSION}.zip"
ditto -c -k --sequesterRsrc --keepParent "$APP_PATH" "$ZIP_PATH"

echo
echo "Built: $ZIP_PATH"
echo
echo "Next:"
echo "  gh release create v${VERSION} ${ZIP_PATH} --title \"Capture v${VERSION}\""

mkdir -p /tmp/capture-split && cp CLAUDE.md README.md /tmp/capture-split/

import subprocess, pathlib
def head(path): return subprocess.run(["git","show","HEAD:"+path],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout
final_claude=pathlib.Path("CLAUDE.md").read_text()
final_readme=pathlib.Path("README.md").read_text()
c=head("CLAUDE.md")
old="- **Ranking**: title-prefix 100 > word-boundary 80 > fuzzy subsequence 40+compactness,"
new="- **Ranking**: title-prefix 100 > exact kind 90 > word-boundary 80 > kind prefix 70 > fuzzy subsequence 40+compactness (typing `project`, `list` or `person` lists that kind; restored 2026-11-02 after the flat-tag move dropped it),"
assert old in c and new in final_claude; pathlib.Path("CLAUDE.md").write_text(c.replace(old,new))
r=head("README.md")
old="Each row shows its kind as a colored chip on the right: project, personal, person, list, agenda, or 15Five."
add=" Type a kind, such as `project`, `list` or `person`, to see every note of that kind."
assert old in r and old+add in final_readme; pathlib.Path("README.md").write_text(r.replace(old,old+add))
EOF
